Maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem - i wanted to lock owners and delivery dates so we can close the epic.
Liam: sounds good, i've got time this sprint to handle token lib and tests.
Maya: items i sketched: 1) upstream token lib adoption + fuzz/e2e tests (owner: Liam, eta: 10bd), 2) service-account permissions tighten + least-privilege matrix (owner: Priya, eta: 7bd), 3) audit collectors schema + retention policy (owner: Carlos, eta: 5bd), 4) secrets rotation playbook + lambda template (owner: Ops, eta: 15bd), 5) recurrence analysis for repeat incidents (owner: Maya, eta: 4bd).
Priya: i'll need the current perm exports, can someone drop link?
Carlos: uploaded audit gaps csv: https://s3.company/internal/audit/gaps-2025-06-20.csv
Liam: question: adopt oauth-token-tools v2.1 now and shim for v2.2 later?
Maya: yes adopt v2.1 and leave a migration note in the PR.
Liam: adding CI fuzz commands to the ticket: `./tools/fuzz_runner --target auth_token --iterations 5000` and `pytest tests/e2e/token_fuzz_test.py`.
Carlos: for collectors i'll add a JSON schema check and fail the pipeline on missing fields. snippet: `{"type":"object","properties":{"request_id":{"type":"string"},"user":{"type":"object"}}}`
Maya: include alerting: if missing fields >5 in 1h, fire `audit:missing_fields:high` -> pager to eng-oncall.
OpsBot: epic REDW-8901 created; tickets REDW-8902..REDW-8905 created and owners assigned. sprint tag `postmortem-remed-2025-s1` added.
Priya: question on retention: proposal is 180d for customer-facing services, 90d for infra-only. i'll update matrix.
Carlos: targeting token-service first, it's highest in the heatmap.
Liam: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/token-tools/pull/312 - tests flaky locally, debugging.
Priya: perms export uploaded to REDW-8903.
Maya: please update the epic board asap and flag blockers. weekly sync: Friday 9am.
Carlos: i'll push audit collector schema PR and add schema tests.
Liam: CI green after fix, moving to review.
OpsBot: rotation-playbook template pushed: https://git.company/ops/rotation-playbook/-/blob/main/playbook.md
Maya: action recap: Liam (token lib + fuzz tests, 10bd), Priya (perm matrix, 7bd), Carlos (audit schema + retention list, 5bd), Ops (rotation playbook + lambda, 15bd), Maya (recurrence analysis, 4bd). owners: update tickets and ping if timelines slip. :thumbsup:
Priya: acked and will add blockers if any.
Maya: closing thread; we'll track progress in the epic and use the Friday sync for status.
